items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: I didn't go into the thing because Elmer Crumbley, the saxophone player, Bill Owens, and everybody came in

ctx.x: Yeh, I remember something like that. You mentioned you lost your first child and, was it a girl?

It was a boy and, do you know what, I didn't go into the thing because Elmer Crumbley, the saxophone player, Bill Owens, and everybody came in and they thought with the excitement that they had caused the death of the child, because they had a midwife and things and what have you. Later on then Joanne came, you see. You must remember, Milt, that going through and coming out of Depression... we helped each other rear our children and what have you. A lot of peoples do not know the fact that we musicians out here,…
